Bangladesh Sustainable and Renewable Energy Association (BSREA)

Job Circular – Event & Program Officer

Position Title: Event & Program Officer

Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh

Employment Type: Full-time

Salary: 30000-40000 BDT

Reports to: Company Secretary

About BSREA

Bangladesh Sustainable and Renewable Energy Association (BSREA) is the apex private sector organization promoting sustainable and renewable energy in Bangladesh. Since its establishment in 2011, BSREA has been working closely with the Government, development partners, industry leaders, and civil society to accelerate clean energy deployment, policy reform, and private sector growth.

BSREA regularly organizes high-level conferences, policy dialogues, training programs, exhibitions, and member engagement initiatives. We are now seeking a proactive, organized, and energetic Event & Program Officer to support the planning, coordination, and delivery of these activities.

This role is ideal for a dynamic professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to contribute to Bangladesh’s clean energy transition.

Key Responsibilities

Event Planning & Coordination

  • Plan, organize, and coordinate conferences, seminars, workshops, exhibitions, fairs, and meetings.
  • Liaise with venues, vendors, media partners, and logistics providers to ensure smooth event delivery.
  • Prepare event plans, budgets, timelines, and operational checklists.
  • Coordinate on-site event execution, including registration, guest management, and logistics.
  • Ensure proper visibility and branding of BSREA events in collaboration with the Branding & Communication Officer.

Program & Project Support

  • Support the implementation of BSREA’s programs and donor-funded projects.
  • Assist in preparing project concepts, proposals, progress reports, and event documentation.
  • Coordinate with partners, stakeholders, and members for joint activities and initiatives.

Member & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Support membership services through engagement programs, networking events, and briefings.
  • Act as focal point for BSREA members regarding event participation.
  • Maintain and update databases of members, stakeholders, speakers, and participants.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for external partners, vendors, speakers, and attendees.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Draft event reports, meeting minutes, and summaries for internal and external circulation.
  • Collect and analyze participant feedback to improve future programs.
  • Support donor and partner reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate with communications teams to promote events and programs through newsletters, social media, and other channels.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Event Management, Business Administration, Development Studies, Communications, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of proven experience in event management, program coordination, NGO or private sector project support.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Bangla.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a dynamic work environment.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Interest in renewable energy, sustainability, or climate change will be considered a strong asset.
  • Willingness to work beyond regular hours during major events, when required.

Compensation

A competitive salary and benefits package will be offered, commensurate with qualifications and experience. The indicative salary range for this position is BDT 30,000–40,000 per month (gross).

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to submit:

  • A detailed CV (maximum 3 pages), and
  • A concise cover letter explaining suitability for the role

Please send applications to: info@bsreabd.org

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

For any information, contact: +880 9647-200500

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
